hidden_risks: whether the seller actually possesses the physical item
functional status of the motor and internal mechanisms
presence and condition of essential accessories like the foot pedal and power adapter
actual physical wear, scratches, or defects
response.best_proof: A real photograph of the actual sewing machine taken by the seller, including its accessories and power cord.
seller_claims_unsupported: actual physical condition of the item
response.drop_reason: Seller is using stock/promotional catalogue photos instead of pictures of the actual item being sold.
response.failure_mode: AI might value the item assuming pristine condition from stock photos, failing to account for the risk that the seller is using catalogue images and the actual unit may be used, damaged, or unavailable.
